summary: Liberty Defense Holdings, Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a Notice of Annual General Meeting and Record Date issued via Computershare, its transfer agent. The notice sets a record date of October 8, 2026 for notice, voting and beneficial ownership determination, with the AGM scheduled for November 27, 2026 in Vancouver, BC. The only voting security is common shares, CUSIP 53044R867. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, premiums or board recommendations on a transaction are stated.
